verdict.rationale: Microsoft Authenticator is an authentication and credential app, so issuing scoped credentials is a fair axis for it. However, the evidence only documents MFA approvals, OTP codes, passkeys, password autofill and Verified IDs for human sign-in. Nothing shows it can issue scoped or least-privilege API credentials for an agent, and the probes found no API surface at all. Verified IDs are an adjacent credential feature for websites and organizations, not agent API keys, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
